title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 9901 (AKU HT 31360)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 9901

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 31360

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 31360; AKU grapheme Y0030 (AKU GR 735). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Y5 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 540. Occurrence: line 1; find place Deir el-Medina; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 8.6 x 7.7 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
